440	def build_output(out_packets, jobrec, jobstatus, nconn, cids, csplits,
   441	                 clabels, cpkts, votes, C):
   442	    plist = []
   443	    pap = plist.append
   444	    for (pi, ci, gen, fwd, dec, credit, jid) in out_packets:
   445	        pap({"index": pi, "connection": cids[ci], "generation": gen,
   446	             "forward": fwd, "decision": dec, "credit": credit, "job": jid})
   447	
   448	    jlist = []
   449	    jap = jlist.append
   450	    for jid, rec in enumerate(jobrec):
   451	        pi, ci, s, gen, lane, start, done, codes, logits, pred = rec
   452	        jap({"id": jid, "packet": pi, "connection": cids[ci], "slot": s,
   453	             "generation": gen, "lane": lane, "start": start, "done": done,
   454	             "window": [[c >> 4, c & 15] for c in codes],
   455	             "logits": list(logits), "prediction": pred,
   456	             "status": jobstatus[jid]})
   457	
   458	    clist = []
   459	    cap = clist.append
   460	    preds = [None] * nconn
   461	    for i in range(nconn):
   462	        v = votes[i]
   463	        if cpkts[i] == 0:
   464	            pr = None
   465	        else:
   466	            mx = max(v)
   467	            pr = v.index(mx)
   468	        preds[i] = pr
   469	        cap({"id": cids[i], "split": csplits[i], "label": clabels[i],
   470	             "packets": cpkts[i], "votes": list(v), "prediction": pr})
   471	
   472	    reports = {}
   473	    for split in ("dev", "eval"):
   474	        confusion = [[0] * C for _ in range(C)]
   475	        observed = 0
   476	        total = Fraction(0)
   477	        for i in range(nconn):
   478	            if csplits[i] != split:
   479	                continue
   480	            pr = preds[i]
   481	            if pr is None:
   482	                continue
   483	            observed += 1
   484	            confusion[clabels[i]][pr] += 1
   485	        for c in range(C):
   486	            tp = confusion[c][c]
   487	            colsum = 0
   488	            for r in range(C):
   489	                colsum += confusion[r][c]
   490	            rowsum = sum(confusion[c])
   491	            fp = colsum - tp
   492	            fn = rowsum - tp
   493	            den = 2 * tp + fp + fn
   494	            if den == 0:
   495	                continue
   496	            total += Fraction(2 * tp, den)
   497	        macro = total / C
   498	        reports[split] = {"connections": observed, "confusion": confusion,
   499	                          "macro_f1": [macro.numerator, macro.denominator]}
   500	
   501	    return {"packets": plist, "jobs": jlist, "connections": clist,
   502	            "reports": reports}
   503

   505	def run(doc):
   506	    need_obj(doc, ROOT_KEYS)
   507	    need_int(doc["version"], 1, 1)
   508	    model = parse_model(doc["model"])
   509	    C = model[0]
   510	    K = model[2]
   511	    cfg = parse_config(doc["config"], C)
   512	    W = cfg[1]
   513	    if K > W:
   514	        raise Invalid("kernel wider than window")
   515	    conn_info = parse_connections(doc["connections"], cfg[0], C)
   516	    packets = parse_packets(doc["packets"], conn_info[0])
   517	    return replay(cfg, model, conn_info, packets)

   520	def main():
   521	    out = None
   522	    try:
   523	        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
   524	        if len(data) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES:
   525	            raise Invalid("input too large")
   526	        text = data.decode("utf-8")
   527	        doc = json.loads(text, parse_float=_reject_float,
   528	                         parse_constant=_reject_float,
   529	                         object_pairs_hook=_object_hook)
   530	        result = run(doc)
   531	        out = json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":"),
   532	                         ensure_ascii=True).encode("ascii") + b"\n"
   533	    except Invalid:
   534	        out = ERROR_OUT
   535	    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError, MemoryError, KeyError,
   536	            TypeError, IndexError):
   537	        # malformed JSON, bad encoding, absurd nesting: all contract violations
   538	        out = ERROR_OUT
   539	    except Exception:
   540	        try:
   541	            traceback.print_exc()
   542	        except Exception:
   543	            pass
   544	        out = ERROR_OUT
   545	    try:
   546	        sys.stdout.buffer.write(out)
   547	        sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
   548	    except Exception:
   549	        pass

   552	if __name__ == "__main__":
   553	    main()
